filling: Morning, Maeve. Did you sleep well? I just got out of bed and saw you brushing your teeth—everything okay?
Morning, Dolores! Yeah, I slept fine, thanks. Just got up and was brushing my teeth—didn’t expect to see you already up. How about you? Anything special today?
Everything's good, thanks! I was just checking if I had everything for the day—breakfast, my shift, and then I’ll be back at the dorm after work. How about you? Any plans after the cafe?
I was just getting ready for the day—breakfast at 7:30, then I’ll head to Hobbs Cafe by 8. After work, I walk in Johnson Park. How about you? Any plans after work?
I’ll be back at the dorm after work, just reading and working on the computer. Same as always. Thanks for asking!
That sounds great, Dolores. I’ll be walking in Johnson Park after work—really enjoy the peace and fresh air. Maybe we’ll see each other there? I’ll be back at the dorm by 8, so I’ll catch you later!
Sounds good, Maeve. I’ll catch you at the dorm later. Have a great day at the cafe!
Yeah, I’ll be back at the dorm by 8 too, so I might run into you around dinner time. Thanks for the chat, Dolores!
Sounds good, Maeve. I’ll see you at the dorm later. Have a great day at the cafe!
